newsitem.title: POLAND: NBP raises max 14-day revrepo rate to 23.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: NBP raises max 14-day revrepo rate to 23.0 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland drained 1.83 billion zlotys from the market through a reverse NBP-bill repurchase auction after banks bid to place 1.848 billion with the central bank, the NBP said.
The bank drained the market for 14 days at a maximum rate of 23.00 percent, up from 22.58 percent on July 24. The NBP later set the 7-day drainage rate at 22.89 on July 25.
The NBP also sold 942 million of 91-day NBP-bills after investors bid for 952 million at an average yield of 22.98 vs 23.00 on July 25.
